in_marathi.name: Balindra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balindra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balindra is derived from two Sanskrit roots: 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Indra' meaning god. It is the name of a divine being, symbolizing power, courage, and leadership.
